questions: Does overheating occur immediately or after running for some time?
recommended_procedure: Follow approved safety and isolation procedures.
Check for abnormal vibration and noise at the bearing housings.
Inspect external cooling paths and fan for obstruction.
Review operating load and current against nameplate rating.
If abnormal conditions are confirmed, escalate to qualified maintenance personnel.
safety_notes: Isolate and lock out the motor before any physical inspection.

questions: Does the motor hum but not rotate?
Does the protection breaker trip immediately?
Was the motor running normally before this happened?

causes.cause: Blown fuse or tripped overload relay

recommended_procedure: Follow approved safety and isolation procedures.
Check supply voltage on all three phases.
Inspect overload relay and fuses.
Manually check the shaft can turn freely when isolated.
Escalate to an electrician if supply and protection are healthy.
safety_notes: Never bypass a tripped overload without investigating the cause.

questions: Is there unusual noise resembling gravel or rattling (possible cavitation)?
Has suction line strainer been checked recently?
Has flow dropped suddenly or gradually?
recommended_procedure: Follow approved safety and isolation procedures.
Check suction strainer and filter for blockage.
Inspect for suction-side air leaks.
Check impeller condition if accessible.
Escalate to qualified maintenance personnel if unresolved.
safety_notes: Relieve system pressure before opening any pump casing.

questions: Does the belt drift to one side consistently?
Is the drift worse under load or empty?
Have idlers or rollers been inspected recently?
recommended_procedure: Follow approved safety and isolation procedures.
Inspect idler and pulley alignment along the full length.
Check for uneven material loading.
Inspect belt edges for wear or damage.
Escalate to qualified maintenance personnel if unresolved.
safety_notes: Never reach into a running conveyor to adjust tracking.

questions: Has the intercooler or aftercooler been checked?
Is the ambient temperature unusually high?
Has oil level and quality been checked?

causes.cause: Low oil level or degraded lubricant

recommended_procedure: Follow approved safety and isolation procedures.
Check and clean intercooler/aftercooler fins.
Check oil level and condition.
Inspect valves for leakage if temperature stays high.
Escalate to qualified maintenance personnel if unresolved.
safety_notes: Allow the compressor to depressurize fully before opening any panel.
